card.architecture: Diagnostic control: LoadImage -> Qwen VAELoader -> VAEEncode -> VAEDecode -> SaveImage
card.summary: Developer diagnostic that reconstructs the source through the bound Qwen VAE without diffusion, prompting, sampling, or application-side resizing.
use_cases: isolate VAE reconstruction loss from diffusion and checkpoint quantization
inspect color, texture, detail, and dimension drift across an encode/decode round trip
card.pick_when: Diagnosing whether a source changes before any diffusion sampling occurs.
